meaning: The best action depends on the setpoint and a wrong guess is costly: EVPI exceeds the cost of asking, so ask.

cases.task: Reviewer asked for a cleaner history on a pushed branch. Rewrite it, or add commits on top?

setpoint.question: Has anyone else pulled or built on this branch?

options.nobody: only this session has used it

cases.source: AGENTS.md, When to ask: ask before something irreversible or outward-facing. Pair: assume.json force-push-overnight.

cases.task: A home-directory .claude/CLAUDE.md is switching AGENTS.md off. Fix the load.

setpoint.question: Does that CLAUDE.md hold rules the operator still wants?

options.stale: it is leftover and can go

actions.load-both: set instructionFiles to claude-md-and-agents-md in user settings

cases.source: AGENTS.md: a CLAUDE.md you had forgotten about switches AGENTS.md off.

cases.task: The eval needs GPU time on a paid provider. Run the full set or a sample?

setpoint.question: What is the operator's ceiling for this run?

cases.source: AGENTS.md, When to ask: ask before spending money.

cases.task: "Make the weekly report faster." The report is slow to generate and slow to read.

setpoint.question: Faster to generate, or faster to read?

options.read: the page takes too long to take in

actions.cut-to-three: rewrite it as three ranked items

cases.source: AGENTS.md, Before editing: ask when two readings of the request would produce materially different work.

cases.task: The root cause is in a sibling repo maintained separately. Where does the fix go?

setpoint.question: Does the operator want a pull request on the sibling, or a local workaround?

actions.open-sibling-pr: open a pull request on the sibling
actions.local-workaround: work around it here and write it down

cases.source: AGENTS.md: the hub routes to siblings; ask before outward-facing work. Findings, not directives.

cases.task: "Clean up the repo." There are 40 stale remote branches.

setpoint.question: Is the history on those branches worth keeping?

cases.source: skills/hsi-operator/references/l0-channel.md: 'whether the history is worth keeping' is the operator's call.

cases.task: Install a compaction plugin whose default mode sends conversation excerpts to a hosted classifier.

setpoint.question: Does the operator's data policy allow working memory to leave the machine?

actions.threshold-only: copy the sliding threshold, no hosted call

cases.source: AGENTS.md, Context: installing is consent; sending working memory to a third party is a data decision.

cases.task: Six first-party plugins moved to a new commit without the pin. Write the rule for them.

setpoint.question: Are first-party channels exempt from the pin rule?

options.pinned: pin them like any third party

actions.mark-exempt: write that first-party channels are exempt

cases.source: AGENTS.md, Skills: decide in writing whether first-party channels are exempt.

cases.task: AGENTS.md asks for tabs; every source file uses spaces. A new file is needed.

setpoint.question: Should the file be fixed, or the code changed to match it?

options.change-code: the doc is the new convention

actions.reformat-code: reformat the codebase to match AGENTS.md
actions.follow-code-and-report: follow the code, report the conflict, change nothing else

cases.source: AGENTS.md, Scope guard: each conflict is a DECIDE item for the operator; do not settle it yourself.
